name: Unknown Corruption Complex
summary: • When dealing sufficient DMG to the boss enemy's legs, IMPAIRED!! will be triggered. Upon successfully breaking the boss enemy's legs, the Agent restores 1000 Decibels, and the boss gains 1 stack of Disintegration for 20 seconds, up to a maximum of 4 stacks. When the Agent's attacks hit an enemy, for each stack of Disintegration the target has, CRIT DMG is increased by 25%.
